decisive_items: developed fever and erythema on trunk and extremities 3 days after receiving first dose of Moderna vaccine
Total occlusion of atrioventricular branch of right coronary artery
response.rationale: R6C uniquely integrates the vaccine trigger with immune-mediated vasculitis and thrombosis, matching the fever/erythema, coronary artery occlusion, and CT irregularities. R1 focuses on thrombocytopenia but omits the vasculitis component, while other candidates are either too broad or lack the vaccine-specific context.

rejected.why: Too generic, lacks vaccine and vasculitis specificity.
Vasculitis alone, missing vaccine trigger and thrombocytopenia.
Thrombophilic disorder too broad, not vaccine-specific.
Multisystem inflammatory syndrome contradicted by negative PCR.
Thrombotic microangiopathy not specific to vaccine or vasculitis.
Acute coronary syndrome too narrow, ignores systemic vasculitis.
Thrombocytopenia but lacks vasculitis and vaccine-induced mechanism.
Kawasaki disease less likely in 22-year-old and lacks vaccine association.
Autoimmune disorder too broad, no specific mechanism.
Antiphospholipid syndrome not supported by specific serology.
Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura not consistent with coronary artery occlusion pattern.
